manifest.stationMeaning: Named railway=station source nodes, including mainline rail. Nearest joins exclude explicit access no/private/permit/military and inactive proposed/construction/disused/abandoned/demolished stations; retained metadata marks eligible=false. Missing access is unknown, not proof of public access. Coordinates are station points, not entrances. Distances are straight-line, no walking/transfer/step-free inference.
manifest.btsMeaning: Explicit source network/operator or directly associated route via stop_area membership. All named Thai station nodes are searched, no nearest-centroid or station-code-prefix classification.
manifest.lineMeaning: OSM route relation IDs linked directly or through explicit stop_area membership. Directional relations may repeat a line. Missing association stays unknown.
manifest.originMeaning: Named original shop=hairdresser/barber node points inside catalogue bounds only. No polygon centroids/geocoding/availability claim.
manifest.parkingMeaning: Shortest straight-line to original amenity=parking geometry, zero inside; only <=150m. Closest-any, closest-not-explicitly-restricted and closest-explicit-yes/permissive/designated are distinct. Neither means venue-owned, on-site, available or reachable parking.

parkingAccessMeaning.access_tagged: access yes/permissive/designated in OSM; availability/fees not assured
parkingAccessMeaning.customers: access customers; relationship to this venue unknown
parkingAccessMeaning.private_or_no: access private/no; not a parking recommendation
parkingAccessMeaning.unknown: No access tag; not proof of public access

manifest.parkingDisplayMeaning: Geometry only for referenced parking within30m of at least one workplace; polygon display simplified30m. Metadata for every referenced parking remains in journey-places.json; distance always uses original geometry.
